activity_summary: At the copying pass you mended the one vault cue two men had heard differently, and you kept the fire on the word light. You let go a better word for the Friar and a turn in the Nurse's lament. Sam, holding the ink, said you had obeyed the rule mostly applied to boys. Heminges did not praise you. Larkham's boy took four lines to the Bell with the letter of the 16th and the six lines of the 24th. The four lines say the lovers are played on Saturday. No sum was set for the copying.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Chose the cue, let two changes go, and gave the boy the four lines.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Laid the rolls in a row, struck the rejected hearing, and wiped the pen.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused to praise the restraint, and sent the packet by the boy.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Held the ink, named the rule, and sanded the Friar's place.
